anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Nadia Marsh. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Ashford in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Stonebridge answers! Darius Mendez and Sanne Adeyemi and Nadia Reyes and Maya Petrov and Hana Weiss and Zoe Adeyemi will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Felix Kowalski and Dmitri Calhoun will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Ashford answers! Tariq Ford and Hana Sato will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
